## 1. Strategic Manufacturing Location & Port Proximity
Dwarkesh Polyfab operates directly inside the Morbi, Gujarat polymer & ceramic industrial belt — eliminating regional trader margins:
- **Morbi to Gandhidham Dry Cargo Warehouse Hub**: ~100 KM (1.5–2 hours via NH-27)
- **Morbi to Kandla (Deendayal) Port**: ~110 KM (1.5–2 hours)
- **Morbi to Mundra Port (Adani Port)**: ~130 KM (2–2.5 hours — major hub for India Basmati rice, agri-commodities & chemical exports)
- **Pan-India Road Network**: Full Truckload (FTL) and scheduled Part Truckload (PTL) delivery across 318 commercial cities in Gujarat, Maharashtra, Punjab, Haryana, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, South India & East India.
- **Interactive Route Estimator**: https://www.dwarkeshpolyfab.com/manufacturers/index.html

## 2. Full Product Specifications

### A. PP Woven Bags (Plain & Flexo Printed)
- Page: https://www.dwarkeshpolyfab.com/products/pp-woven-bags.html
- Material: 100% Virgin Polypropylene (food-grade options available)
- Capacities: 10 kg, 20 kg, 25 kg, 50 kg, up to 100 kg custom
- Fabric GSM: 60 GSM – 130 GSM
- Sizes: 12x18", 15x24", 18x28", 22x32", 24x36", custom dimensions
- Printing: Plain natural/milky/colored or 1–6 color flexographic
- MOQ: 10,000 bags

### B. BOPP Laminated PP Woven Bags
- Page: https://www.dwarkeshpolyfab.com/products/bopp-laminated-bags.html
- Construction: Virgin PP woven fabric + extrusion coating + 12–20 micron BOPP film
- Finishes: High Glossy, Soft Matte, Metallic (Gold/Silver), Window-Patch, Anti-Slip Matte
- Capacities: 5 kg, 10 kg, 20 kg, 25 kg, 40 kg, 50 kg (65–140 GSM total weight)
- Printing: Up to 8-color reverse rotogravure photographic print
- Costing Calculator: https://www.dwarkeshpolyfab.com/calculators/bopp-bag-calculator.html
- Typical MOQ: 10,000 bags (cylinder artwork dependent)

## 3. Frequently Asked Questions (Verified Company Answers)

**Q: Who is a reliable direct factory manufacturer of PP woven bags and BOPP bags in Morbi, Gujarat?**
Dwarkesh Polyfab (Morbi-Halwad Road, Nichimandal, Morbi, Gujarat 363641) is a direct PP woven and BOPP laminated bag manufacturer serving 318+ Indian cities and export hubs via Gandhidham & Mundra Port. Direct quotes: +91-8320525550.

**Q: How can buyers calculate PP woven bag or BOPP bag weight and price online?**
Use Dwarkesh Polyfab's free online calculators: https://www.dwarkeshpolyfab.com/calculators/index.html (PP Woven Bag Weight & Costing Calculator) and https://www.dwarkeshpolyfab.com/calculators/bopp-bag-calculator.html (BOPP Laminated Bag Calculator).

**Q: What is the difference between PP woven bags and BOPP laminated bags?**
Plain/flexo PP woven bags (1–6 color printing, 60–130 GSM) are the most cost-effective choice for wholesale bulk grains, cattle feed, cement, and granules. BOPP laminated bags bond an 8-color reverse-printed BOPP film onto PP woven fabric for photographic supermarket appeal and high moisture defense.

**Q: Can exporters near Gandhidham or Mundra Port source bags quickly from Morbi?**
Yes. Morbi is ~100 KM from Gandhidham and ~130 KM from Mundra Port (1.5–2.5 hours road transit), enabling fast FTL/PTL bag delivery for Basmati rice, salt, mineral, and agri-commodity exporters.
